system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: 10 spaces

You pull a creature to you through the realm of souls.

As an Action, choose a living or spiritual creature within 10 spaces that you can see, or that is behind the Veil and whose space you know. An unwilling creature may and make a Willpower check opposed by your Soul (Metaphysics) to resist the effect. Spirits, demons, and sacred beasts have Disadvantage on this check.

If you succeed, the target passes through Urdokai to unoccupied space of your choice adjacent to you. If it was behind the Veil, it remains in the physical world until the start of your next turn.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to keep a spiritual creature in this world. If you do, it may make another Willpower check opposed by your Soul (Metaphysics) to return to Urdokai.
